title: Putnami Lock File
description: Unified lock file for the CLI, toolchains, extensions, templates, and agent-workflow artifacts. Generated by Putnami install/pin workflows and committed for reproducible builds.

cli.description: Which putnami engine this workspace runs: a published pin (version plus per-platform executable digests), or the reserved source "workspace" sentinel for a workspace that builds its own CLI from its own tree.

version.description: Resolved CLI version. Absent for a source workspace, which pins no published artifact.

integrity.description: Legacy single-platform executable digest. Superseded by `integrities`.

integrities.description: Per-platform executable SHA-256 hashes keyed by "os/arch" (e.g. "linux/amd64").

manifestHash.description: Reserved for compatibility with shared lock entries; not used for CLI pins.

source.description: Download URL used to pin the CLI, or the reserved literal "workspace" when the workspace builds its own CLI from its own tree.

protocolVersion.description: Machine-output protocol version emitted by this exact CLI.

toolchains.description: Exact toolchain releases keyed by lock identity: any identity an extension's runtime.toolchains declarations name and an extension answers the toolchain-resolve call for. Each entry records, per platform, the archive to download and the SHA-256 that binds its bytes.

extensions.description: Map of extension names to locked version info.

integrity.description: Legacy single-platform archive integrity hash (sha256:...). Superseded by `integrities`; retained for backward compatibility.

integrities.description: Per-platform archive integrity hashes keyed by "os/arch" (e.g. "linux/amd64"). Lets one committed lock verify on every supported platform.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the manifest file for tamper detection.

source.description: Download URL or path used to install.

taskContract.description: Task-contract protocol declared by the pinned extension manifest.

templates.description: Map of template names to locked version info.

integrity.description: Legacy single-platform archive integrity hash (sha256:...). Superseded by `integrities`; retained for backward compatibility.

integrities.description: Per-platform archive integrity hashes keyed by "os/arch" (e.g. "linux/amd64"). Lets one committed lock verify on every supported platform.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the manifest file for tamper detection.

source.description: Download URL or path used to install.

agentArtifacts.description: Map of legacy agent-workflow artifact names to the exact, platform-independent pins earlier releases installed. A current CLI never adds one, and `putnami install` drops every one.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of the platform-independent artifact archive.

source.description: Download URL or path used to install.

platform.description: Platform key: an "os/arch" pair as Go spells them, such as "darwin/arm64".

toolchainEntry.description: One toolchain pinned to an exact release. `archives` and `integrities` name the same platforms: the archive tells a reader what to download and where the executable sits, and the integrity binds the archive's bytes. Member order is a contract: `archives` is written before `integrities`, because a line reader takes the last platform line of an entry as that platform's digest.

archives.description: Each platform's archive, keyed by platform.

integrities.description: SHA-256 of each platform's archive, keyed by platform.

toolchainArchive.description: One platform's archive of a toolchain release. The integrity recorded for the same platform binds its bytes, so the url names a location and vouches for no content.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL of the archive, with a host and no user information.

executable.description: Slash-separated path of the toolchain's executable relative to the unpacked archive's root, such as "go/bin/go". No empty, "." or ".." segment, no backslash, no leading slash and no drive letter.
